response.rationale: Multifocal osteolysis including a separate parietal skull lesion strongly favors Langerhans cell histiocytosis, whereas cholesteatoma would not produce a distant skull vault lytic lesion. The ear canal polyp and otorrhea fit LCH presenting as refractory otomastoiditis.

rejected.why: Cholesteatoma cannot explain the separate left parietal osteolytic lesion and is unlikely to produce bilateral temporal bone destruction with an additional distant skull lesion.
